items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I’ve studied scores, you know, classical scores and Thad Jones and Duke Ellington scores

ctx.x: Because anybody who would be that person probably wouldn’t be studying with someone like me. Because I’ve been around a long time and I’ve developed a lot of things, theory-wise. I mean I’m not sure I can play them all, but I’ve studied them all. I’ve studied scores, you know, classical scores and Thad Jones and Duke Ellington scores, and I’ve seen a lot of harmonic complexity, there’s nothing that really throws me, as far as talking theory. Now what I can actually play, that’s something I’m still working on. I…
Earlier you were talking about going to New York and you landed the Lionel Hampton gig and worked with Brother Jack McDuff I think, what kind of things did you learn from those guys, if anything?
